title: Plan changes on their own card
narrative: A customer-support agent can carry a separate count-based card for active subscription changes. That card can be changed or revoked without disturbing its refund or store-credit authority.

steps.description: The subscription is active, but no Plan Change Card has been issued.
An owner issues a Plan Change Card for up to 40 authorizations per day.
KIFF authorizes one plan change and draws one from this card. The billing system applies the change afterwards.
